## Trail

- Trail folder: `trails/NNNN-name`
- [ ] `00-frame.jsonl` was written before any file changed (Log Before Act)
- [ ] Proofs were re-run with real output, and at least one must-fail case failed first
- [ ] A separate Checker wrote the verdict (PASS, LOOP or HALT); the author did not score their own work
- [ ] Only relative paths in trail files
- [ ] Not sealed by the author; sealing waits for the owner

## Ask-first items touched (tick any, the owner decides)

- [ ] laws or policy   - [ ] deleting   - [ ] installing   - [ ] spending   - [ ] more authority for a bot
